resolution_model: Resolve the September 2026 P22 snapshot through explicit official-unavailable evidence states when the exact governed current county observation cannot be published without violating freshness, geography or measure-definition rules. These are not zeros and are designed to be superseded when a later official source satisfies the contract.

families.period_label: as of 1 Sep 2026 · latest county reference month Jun 2026 (stale)
families.source: National Drought Management Authority — County Drought Early Warning Bulletins
families.reason: The official NDMA county listing exposes June 2026 as the latest county bulletin reference month for the governed ASAL counties. At the 1 September 2026 P22 snapshot, June is three calendar months behind and fails the contract's maximum two-month current-label tolerance. The newer July 2026 national bulletin is control evidence only and cannot be inherited to counties. P22 therefore resolves the current county alert slot as officially unavailable under the freshness contract rather than displaying a stale warning as current.
families.refresh_trigger: Replace this evidence state when an official NDMA county bulletin is available within the P22 freshness tolerance and its county alert state is deterministically extracted.

families.period_label: as of 1 Sep 2026 · 2026 LRA listed, classification payload not deterministically resolved
families.source: National Drought Management Authority / Kenya Food Security Steering Group — Long Rains Assessment 2026
families.reason: The official NDMA resource index confirms the Long Rains Assessment National Report 2026 was published in August 2026, but the governed pipeline does not yet have a stable official payload exposing exact classification geography, county phase values and current/projected validity intervals. The older 2025 Short Rains Assessment windows ended by June 2026. P22 therefore does not infer IPC phases from a listing, a report title, an expired classification, livelihood-zone evidence or partial-county evidence; the exact current whole-county classification is resolved as officially unavailable for this snapshot.
families.refresh_trigger: Replace this evidence state when the official 2026 LRA payload or equivalent official endpoint exposes source-supported whole-county phases and explicit validity intervals that pass the P22 geography/freshness gate.

families.period_label: as of 1 Sep 2026 · KMD Aug 2026 products reviewed
families.source: Kenya Meteorological Department — August 2026 agrometeorological bulletin and official climate products
families.reason: Fresh official KMD material is available, including the August 2026 agrometeorological bulletin, but it provides qualitative county-group forecasts and station-level review rather than one direct numeric rainfall/temperature anomaly value for each governed county with an explicit climatological baseline and county aggregation method. Historical KMD anomaly maps are not reverse-engineered into county numbers. P22 therefore resolves the exact governed county anomaly observation as officially unavailable rather than manufacturing values from qualitative language, stations, map colours or unapproved spatial interpolation.
families.refresh_trigger: Replace this evidence state when KMD publishes a direct county anomaly table or an approved gridded KMD source can be deterministically aggregated to counties with baseline, window, method and boundary metadata preserved.

guardrails: The closure covers exactly the 22 whole-county ASAL geographies in the active P22 contract; Nyeri/Kieni remains partial and excluded.
No closure state represents zero, normal conditions, IPC phase 1 or absence of drought unless the official source explicitly says so.
Stale/historical evidence remains available for provenance but is never relabelled current.
National, regional, livelihood-zone, station or partial-county evidence is never inherited to a whole county.
Every closure has an explicit refresh trigger so later official data can supersede the snapshot without changing the governed definition.
